description:
What is This Part?
These are the Metal Collars that go between the Body and the Frame.
These Metal Collars Insert Inside Rubber Washers (sold seperately)
This is a Complete Set
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 6 – Collars
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
